messages:
Jena (docs): Heads up — I need a mini cherry-pick of the Go SDK snippet in the migration guide. Link anchor changed and the preview linkcheck failed. Short window to land before next staging deploy at 17:00 UTC. Can someone pick this up? :eyes:

Omar (docs): I can take the review. Is it just the snippet and a linkfix?

Jena (docs): Yep. PR is #2437 on docs. Changed the Go example to the new Client v2 API, and an anchor rename broke the internal link. Also CI preview failing with linkcheck + a large image causing timeout.

Ben (sdk): pinging — the Go SDK change is tiny. Example now uses NewClientWithOpts(ctx) instead of NewClient(). Should be safe to validate.

Ben (sdk): snippet:
```go
client, err := sdk.NewClientWithOpts(ctx, sdk.WithEndpoint("https://api.redwood.ai"))
if err != nil { return err }
resp, _ := client.Generate(ctx, "hello")
```
No deep code review needed, just confirm imports and formatting.

Priya (eng): FYI preview builder timed out at 9m on that branch yesterday. If we trim the big topology diagram PNG it should pass. Maybe replace with a smaller SVG or lazy-load it.

Jena (docs): Good call. I removed the large PNG in the branch and pushed. PR now has the fix + cherry-pick commit.

doc-preview-bot: Preview build started for PR #2437 — staging preview URL: https://preview.redwood.ai/pr-2437 — status: building

kate (triage): Heads up — merge freeze starts at 16:30 UTC for the infra rollout. We can still merge to staging but production main is blocked until 18:00 UTC.

Omar (docs): Plan: I'll review the snippet now, run linkcheck locally, and if green, can we merge to staging and run the preview? @kate will hold main merge until after 18:00.

Ben (sdk): LGTM from SDK side. One nit: use context variable name ctx in example — consistent with SDK style.

Omar (docs): Local linkcheck passed. Small fix to anchor path in migration.md line 214. Pushed commit.

doc-preview-bot: Preview build succeeded for PR #2437 — staging preview: https://preview.redwood.ai/pr-2437 — status: success

kate (triage): staging merge ok. I'll schedule the main merge at 18:05 UTC to avoid freeze risk. Can someone do the final approval then?

Priya (eng): I can do final approve at 18:05 if nothing changes.

Jena (docs): Amazing, thanks everyone. @Ben @Omar @Priya — please thumbs up when you've approved so I can merge at scheduled time. :pray: 

Omar (docs): :thumbsup: 

Ben (sdk): :thumbsup: 

Priya (eng): :thumbsup: 

Jena (docs): Merged to staging and verified preview. Main merge scheduled; will merge at 18:05 if no blockers.
